changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate 'mathematical reasoning' task variant and normalized capitalization. Simplified output descriptions to remove redundant phrasing while preserving meaning.

Removed metrics that are not actual evaluation metrics (reward, completion length are training metrics) and simplified to core accuracy metric. Pass@1 and exact match are not explicitly mentioned as separate metrics.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used; paper uses only accuracy-based automatic evaluation.
No human evaluation conducted; paper relies exclusively on automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on reasoning capabilities in LLMs through chain-of-thought generation and evaluates primarily using accuracy metrics across mathematical, coding, and language understanding tasks. No LLM-as-judge or human evaluation methods are employed.
